primary_annotation_design: two independent external raters with condition-hidden adjudication
self_annotation_design: separate condition-hidden investigator sensitivity sheet; never pooled with the primary external-rater endpoint or counted as an independent external rater
compensation_plan: Proposed: INR 15,000 per primary rater for a complete 1,280-item batch, paid within seven working days after valid return; pro-rated on withdrawal. Recruitment is blocked until the owner confirms funds and payment logistics and the responsible ethics authority reviews the terms.
data_retention_plan: Conditions remain private until adjudication; final de-identified labels and agreement statistics may be released under the selected project terms.
withdrawal_process: Draft: participants may request withdrawal by email using a private participant code until 30 days after batch return or irreversible destruction of the identity-to-label link, whichever occurs first. Remove identifiable labels before that cutoff where feasible; explain that removal is not possible after irreversible de-identification and aggregation. Authority review and a confirmed retention/deletion schedule are pending.
notes: The owner selected two independent external raters for the primary endpoint plus a separately reported self-annotation sensitivity analysis and explicitly authorized computational model training on 2026-10-17. Training does not recruit or interact with human participants. On 2026-10-29, a consent draft and proposed compensation/withdrawal terms were prepared; they are not authority-approved or an available-funds commitment. Recruitment and annotation remain prohibited until the responsible authority issues and records a real determination, materials are reviewed, funds/logistics and retention are confirmed, and annotation clearance is validly recorded.
